557725326:struggling.h: R. Marriott Was Supposed to Be a Star, and the Turnovers Say No
557725326:struggling.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] threw 17 touchdowns and 16 interceptions for 2924 yards, a 135.8 rating, despite a 90 overall. A source says the staff is quietly checking portal quarterbacks.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The results aren't.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713201:fit.h: M.Carver's coverage skills are going to waste at Penn State, and others see it
557713201:fit.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] is an 85-overall coverage safety on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] pass defense that ranks 131st of 138. Programs that play more disciplined coverage have taken notice. Penn State will have to give him a reason to stay.

quote.text: Safeties like him want to sit on top of routes. That's not what's happening in that defense.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation

557719002:fit.h: N.Pullard is a bump-and-run corner stuck on a defense that gets burned deep
557719002:fit.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] is an 88-overall corner on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense ranked 131st of 138 against the pass. Scouts who like his skill set wonder how long he'll stay in a system that doesn't use it.

quote.text: You have a guy built to press and lock down a side of the field, and he's playing in a defense that gives up chunk plays. Other staffs notice that.

557726826:fit.h: Penn State's secondary woes could push corner J. Zayas toward the exit
557726826:fit.d: [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] is an 83-overall field corner on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense ranked 134th of 138 against the pass. A source says that mismatch is starting to weigh on him. agerm40 needs answers in the secondary.

832438359:streakW16.h: Ohio State is 16-0 and No. 1, and Goh keeps it boring
832438359:streakW16.d: Ohio State is atop the poll with the streak at 16. [[c:Tuddy_Roosevelt|Coach Goh]] has banned the word from the building, according to people around the Buckeyes, and the players have bought in.

quote.text: We don't talk about the streak. We talk about Tuesday practice.
quote.by: Ohio State player, per a source close to the program

831914385:4th:832438348.h: Nebraska's fourth-down aggression costs it against Ohio State
831914385:4th:832438348.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] went for it five times and turned it over on downs three times in the loss to [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. A source close to the Huskers' staff says the sideline was split on the calls, and the postgame mood was tense.

quote.text: You can't hand a No. 1 team short fields all day.
quote.by: a source close to the Nebraska program

561120696battle.h: Boise State holds a slim edge for M. Tam, but Texas Tech is pushing
561120696battle.d: Boise State has the lead for [[r:561120696|M. Tam]], and [[t:832438398|USC]] is lurking. Tam's dealbreaker is playing style, and Texas Tech has been selling hard on how it would use him. Official visits could swing it.

quote.text: He wants to see how they'll actually use him. Slides don't do it for him.
quote.by: a person close to the recruit

561121462battle.h: Indiana barely ahead of BYU for E. Garfield as Minnesota lurks
561121462battle.d: [[r:561121462|E. Garfield]] cares about one thing: playing time. [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has a narrow lead over BYU, and Minnesota is still in the picture. Rival staffers expect both front-runners to push hard on the depth chart this week.

quote.text: He keeps asking who's in front of him. That's the whole conversation.
quote.by: a source familiar with Garfield's recruitment

561125481commit.h: N. Salaam picks Oklahoma over Ole Miss and Alabama
561125481commit.d: [[r:561125481|N. Salaam]] chose the Sooners over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. Oklahoma is a short drive from Dallas, and the family's comfort mattered. NIL money was part of it too, with a reported $290K ask.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. Oklahoma just felt like family.

561123595commit.h: UCLA beats Oregon and Indiana for linebacker T. Edmond
561123595commit.d: [[r:561123595|T. Edmond]] picked [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438364|Oregon]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. He wanted a power-conference stage, and the Bruins' recent run of linebackers going to the NFL got his attention.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561119285commit.h: No. 3 overall T. Burgess stays in California with UCLA
561119285commit.d: [[r:561119285|T. Burgess]] is headed to [[t:832438394|UCLA]]. Seniors [[p:557714286|D.Dixson]] and [[p:557717881|K.Lopa]] are almost out of eligibility, leaving the athlete room open. Burgess never seriously considered leaving the state, and the staff reportedly promised him a real shot at a job.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561119493commit.h: Indiana lands five-star WR T. Coats with brand and NIL pitch
561119493commit.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] landed [[r:561119493|T. Coats]] by selling the national spotlight and putting serious NIL money behind it, a reported $320K ask. Rival recruiters say the Hoosiers' collective has become a real weapon, and they're now stacking top talent.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

561120192commit.h: Tennessee lands five-star edge rusher K. Stockton after a statement win
561120192commit.d: [[r:561120192|K. Stockton]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] after the Vols' 52-7 rout of [[t:832438409|Washington State]]. A source close to the program says the pitch was simple: come hunt quarterbacks in a scheme built for it.

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.

561120664commit.h: No. 6 overall D. McFadden picks Oregon despite home-proximity wish
561120664commit.d: [[r:561120664|D. McFadden]] listed proximity to home as a dealbreaker, then picked [[t:832438364|Oregon]], hundreds of miles away. Oregon's NIL standing and a reported $305K ask carried it, and a source says the family signed off after a long talk.

quote.text: I'm taking care of my family. They understood that.

561125804commit.h: Indiana wins five-star LEDG T. Wayne with a pitch on playing time
561125804commit.d: [[r:561125804|T. Wayne]] picked [[t:832438319|Indiana]] after the staff said he could compete for a job right away. NIL helped, with a reported $280K ask. Rival coaches question how all the Hoosiers' big signings will fit.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561122846commit.h: Miami's NIL muscle and NFL pipeline beat Ole Miss for J. Santana
561122846commit.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] landed defensive lineman [[r:561122846|J. Santana]] over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. Miami's recent run of linemen going to the league helped. Per a source, so did a number that came in around the reported $300K ask.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

561122210commit.h: Miami closes on five-star back K. Ghiaciuc after a long chase
561122210commit.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] won the tug-of-war for [[r:561122210|K. Ghiaciuc]], and it wasn't a quiet one. The Hurricanes met a reported $335K ask. Rival staffers say they knew they were in trouble once the money conversation turned serious.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

561120353commit.h: Oregon outlasts rivals for five-star corner B. Ruffin
561120353commit.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] won a crowded race for [[r:561120353|B. Ruffin]], leaning on its track record of sending defensive backs to the NFL. Ruffin's reported $305K ask didn't scare off a program that spends big.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Oregon develops DBs better than anybody.

561119499commit.h: Georgia and Alabama both miss as S. Shoemaker picks Miami
561119499commit.d: Tackle [[r:561119499|S. Shoemaker]] chose [[t:832438337|Miami]] over [[t:832438312|Georgia]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. A source says the Bulldogs thought they were in good shape late. The loss lands awkwardly for a program with the nation's deepest NIL.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Miami develops tackles better than anybody.

561124027commit.h: Indiana lands five-star quarterback B. Schlereth, and the roster math gets interesting
561124027commit.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] landed [[r:561124027|B. Schlereth]] by selling a title window. The reported $335K price tag is steep, and it adds to a growing pile of Hoosier talent. Somebody will eventually feel the squeeze on NIL or snaps.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561124501commit.h: No. 13 overall A. Stingley picks Tennessee after statement win
561124501commit.d: [[r:561124501|A. Stingley]] is headed to [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], which has momentum after beating [[t:832438409|Washington State]] 52-7. He wanted a power-conference stage, and a source close to him says that win clinched it.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561119943commit.h: Ole Miss beats Miami and Colorado for C. Kearns on a title pitch
561119943commit.d: [[r:561119943|C. Kearns]] picked [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] over [[t:832438337|Miami]] and [[t:832438295|Colorado]]. People close to the recruitment say he kept asking one thing: who is realistically winning it all? Ole Miss had the better answer.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561123078commit.h: No. 15 overall J. Nagy is headed to Texas
561123078commit.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] landed [[r:561123078|J. Nagy]], one of the top prospects in the class. The Longhorns' recent success producing linebackers helped. Per a source, the recruiting staff had been on the phone with the family nearly every night.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Texas develops linebackers better than anybody.

561120796commit.h: No. 16 overall K. Lett picks Tennessee on the promise of early reps
561120796commit.d: [[r:561120796|K. Lett]] is headed to [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], which said he can compete for a job right away. The Vols' 52-7 win over [[t:832438409|Washington State]] sealed it, according to a source around the program.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561121852commit.h: Notre Dame landed K. Yamini after he watched the UTSA rout in person
561121852commit.d: No. 17 overall [[r:561121852|K. Yamini]] is going to [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], and the 59-13 win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]] sealed it. A source says he left the stadium telling people close to him that he was done looking.

quote.text: That win over UTSA? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

561123344commit.h: UCLA keeps California defender N. Vernon from USC and Oregon
561123344commit.d: [[r:561123344|N. Vernon]] picked [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438398|USC]] and [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. His parents will make every home game, and the Bruins' title pitch carried weight. A source says the family loved the campus visit.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. UCLA just felt like family.

561122203commit.h: Ole Miss wins five-star WILL A. Tongue as senior exit opens a spot
561122203commit.d: [[r:561122203|A. Tongue]] chose [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]], where [[p:557723500|J.Anthony-Harrison]] is a senior and the linebacker room is opening up. He also wanted a power-conference stage. A source says the staff stressed his path to the field.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561119408commit.h: No. 20 overall N. Gutierrez picks Alabama as senior exits clear a path
561119408commit.d: [[r:561119408|N. Gutierrez]] is headed to [[t:832438274|Alabama]], where senior [[p:557716740|B.Jacobs]] is running out of eligibility. His reported $280K ask was met. Alabama needed a win, since it missed on several other big names.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561121399commit.h: Oregon beats Tennessee and Notre Dame for S. Purvis
561121399commit.d: [[r:561121399|S. Purvis]] picked [[t:832438364|Oregon]] over [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. He wanted the power-conference stage, and a source says Oregon's NIL, a reported $280K ask, was the tiebreaker.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561125164commit.h: Tennessee's brand and blowout win sell No. 22 recruit J. Cummings
561125164commit.d: No. 22 overall [[r:561125164|J. Cummings]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] because he wanted a national spotlight. The Vols' 52-7 rout of [[t:832438409|Washington State]] only made the pitch easier. Rival recruiters say the Vols' exposure is hard to compete with.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

561125399commit.h: UCLA adds another linebacker as J. Booker turns down LSU and Colorado
561125399commit.d: [[r:561125399|J. Booker]] picked [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438333|LSU]] and [[t:832438295|Colorado]]. Per a source close to the staff, he liked the pass-defense scheme and the draft history. It's another piece of a loaded Bruins linebacker group.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

561123398commit.h: Notre Dame lands five-star LT P. Snead after UTSA rout
561123398commit.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] landed [[r:561123398|P. Snead]] right after the 59-13 win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]]. Snead's reported $280K ask was met, and a source says he texted the staff as soon as the game ended.

quote.text: They beat UTSA and I texted the coach right after. I was ready.

561124438commit.h: Ole Miss lands five-star QB T. Avery on power-conference pitch
561124438commit.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] landed [[r:561124438|T. Avery]], who wanted a power-conference stage. A reported $305K ask was met. A source close to the staff says the quarterback room's future was a big part of the conversation.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561122209commit.h: Notre Dame lands five-star CB N. Judovsky on a head-coach pitch
561122209commit.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] landed [[r:561122209|N. Judovsky]], who said the staff's honesty set it apart. The 59-13 win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]] didn't hurt. A source says the head coach's visit to his school made a difference.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561120159commit.h: Notre Dame keeps five-star WR V. Clausen close to home
561120159commit.d: [[r:561120159|V. Clausen]] picked [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] after a recruiting tug-of-war, and the short trip from Paintsville mattered. The Irish arrive fresh off a 59-13 rout of [[t:832438403|UTSA]], and the commitment gives that offense another weapon.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. Notre Dame just felt like family.

561120899commit.h: Alabama lands No. 28 overall R. Gono, and the guard room just got a lot younger
561120899commit.d: [[r:561120899|R. Gono]] is headed to [[t:832438274|Alabama]], where [[p:557720781|W.Sanders]] runs out of eligibility after this season. Gono's camp reportedly wanted a clear path to the field and a competitive NIL number, and Alabama delivered both.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561121243commit.h: Miami gets its SAM: five-star R. Cave picks the Hurricanes
561121243commit.d: [[r:561121243|R. Cave]] is going to [[t:832438337|Miami]], and sources say the staff sold him on replacing [[p:557725322|E.Marcelin Jr.]] right away. The Hurricanes' NIL money helped, but the promise of early snaps closed it.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561122849commit.h: Oregon beats the field for five-star cornerback T. Duke
561122849commit.d: [[r:561122849|T. Duke]] chose [[t:832438364|Oregon]] after a tight chase. A source close to the recruitment says he wanted a weekly schedule of power-conference receivers, and the Ducks' conference standing and NIL offer did the rest.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561121369commit.h: Five-star athlete S. Tye stays home and commits to UCLA
561121369commit.d: [[r:561121369|S. Tye]] never really looked beyond California, and [[t:832438394|UCLA]] got him. It's the Bruins' latest in-state win. A high school staffer says rival coaches stopped by, but he was never going far from Covina.

quote.text: I'm representing Covina. Staying close was always the plan.

561123214commit.h: Miami adds No. 32 overall J. Gaskin, who says he's here to win it all
561123214commit.d: [[r:561123214|J. Gaskin]] is going to [[t:832438337|Miami]] with a championship on his mind. Gaskin's camp reportedly set a high price, and the Hurricanes met it. That is two big Miami commitments in one stretch.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561125288battle.h: Ole Miss holds a slim edge over Tennessee for J. Mooney, with Clemson lurking
561125288battle.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] has a small lead for [[r:561125288|J. Mooney]], but [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] is close behind. Clemson hasn't gone away. Playing style is his dealbreaker, and both staffs are expected to push their playbooks hard this week.

561125389battle.h: Missouri has a razor-thin edge for K. Keenoy, with Auburn and Georgia in the mix
561125389battle.d: [[r:561125389|K. Keenoy]] is stuck in a three-way chase, and playing time is the deciding factor. Missouri has the slightest lead, but [[t:832438312|Georgia]] and Auburn are still pushing. One strong week for any of them could end it.

561120126battle.h: Florida leads for S. Mafe, but Iowa's open backfield could flip him
561120126battle.d: [[r:561120126|S. Mafe]] is weighing playing time above everything. Florida has the edge, but [[t:832438320|Iowa]] has [[p:557717046|D.Jones]] graduating and a depth chart with a clear opening. Georgia is lurking and could crash the party.

561120556battle.h: Notre Dame and LSU are fighting a late battle for REDG C. McCarron
561120556battle.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] holds a slim lead over [[t:832438333|LSU]] for [[r:561120556|C. McCarron]], who is focused on pro potential. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] is lurking, and one of the big names is going to lose a prized edge rusher.

561125481sign.h: Oklahoma gets five-star tackle N. Salaam, and Dallas is part of the story
561125481sign.d: [[r:561125481|N. Salaam]] signed with [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], and it helped that the Sooners are a short drive from Dallas. Family closeness mattered to him, and the Sooners keep winning recruiting battles along the Red River.

561123595sign.h: UCLA signs five-star linebacker T. Edmond to stack up the defense
561123595sign.d: [[r:561123595|T. Edmond]] picks [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over other power-conference suitors. He wanted to play on the biggest stage, and the Bruins sold their conference standing well. The linebacker room is getting very deep.

557724632:stayed:2028.h: K.Greene stays at Ohio State after a quiet week on Portal Watch
557724632:stayed:2028.d: The buried-on-the-depth-chart [[p:557724632|K.Greene]] is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff reportedly kept him in the loop on his role, which may be why he stayed.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713038:stayed:2028.h: B.Lyle isn't leaving Ohio State, despite the noise
557713038:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] spent a week on Portal Watch because of his depth-chart spot, but he is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Teammate Dre Quinn did enter the portal, so the Buckeyes lost one name but kept the other.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726994:stayed:2028.h: L.Bey Stays at Ohio State, and It Took a Real Sales Job
557726994:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557726994|L.Bey]] sat on Portal Watch for two weeks as an underpaid player in a scheme that didn't fit him. The portal is open and he's still on [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]'s roster. Whether he's actually settled is a different question.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719002:stayed:2028.h: N.Pullard Isn't Leaving Penn State, Despite the Scheme Questions
557719002:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] spent two weeks on Portal Watch as a poor fit for the scheme. The portal is open and he's still on [[t:832438366|Penn State]]'s roster. agerm40 keeps a piece he needed to keep.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726826:stayed:2028.h: J.Zayas Passes on the Portal, Stays at Penn State
557726826:stayed:2028.d: After two weeks on Portal Watch, [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] is still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster with the window open. Scheme-fit chatter followed him all month. By most accounts, he never seriously considered leaving.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719876:stayed:2028.h: Illinois keeps S.Pizzella, but the pay question lingers
557719876:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557719876|S.Pizzella]] was on Portal Watch because he's underpaid for his rating, but he is still on the [[t:832438318|Illinois]] roster. Rival collectives may keep calling, and Illinois may have to answer with a bigger offer.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557725869:stayed:2028.h: N.Rankin stays at Michigan despite being underpaid for his rating
557725869:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557725869|N.Rankin]] is still on the [[t:832438339|Michigan]] roster with the portal open. He was flagged on Portal Watch because of his NIL gap, and a source says he wants to see the season through in Ann Arbor.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724373:stayed:2028.h: S.Elchert is staying at Minnesota, for now
557724373:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557724373|S.Elchert]] was on Portal Watch as an underpaid player, but he is still on the [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] roster. The staff will have to address his NIL before another window opens.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726198:stayed:2028.h: J.Smith is staying at Georgia, a bit of good news after a rough stretch
557726198:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] was on Portal Watch because he's underpaid for his rating, but he is still on the [[t:832438312|Georgia]] roster. After losing S. Shoemaker, the Bulldogs needed this. Georgia's deep NIL pocket could still close the gap.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713037:stayed:2028.h: C.Flanagan stays at Michigan State, but his price is climbing
557713037:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557713037|C.Flanagan]] was flagged for a rating jump that will make him expensive, yet he is still on the [[t:832438340|Michigan State]] roster. Staying put now may mean a bigger contract request soon.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438366:exodus:2028.h: Penn State bleeds 10 players to the portal, including three four-stars
832438366:exodus:2028.d: Four-star receiver Pat Mooney, guard George Nsekhe, edge rusher Marquez Slaughter and seven more entered the portal from [[t:832438366|Penn State]]. Four of the departures are four- or five-star players, and agerm40 has serious rebuilding work ahead.

quote.text: There was a lot of frustration in that room, and it finally boiled over.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438359:exodus:2028.h: Ohio State loses five to the portal, led by guard Tim Coffey
832438359:exodus:2028.d: Four-star guard Tim Coffey, cornerback Jay Timmons, edge rusher Dre Quinn and two more entered the portal from [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Four of the five are four- or five-star players, a real hit for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: Some guys just wanted a bigger role. It's not personal.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438301:exodus:2028.h: East Carolina loses four to the portal, including RB Caden Knighten
832438301:exodus:2028.d: Three-star running back Caden Knighten, cornerback Jeremiah Favorite, middle linebacker Grant Brake and one more entered the portal from [[t:832438301|East Carolina]]. Pirate_flag will have to rework the depth chart quickly.

quote.text: These guys wanted a bigger role, and they weren't going to get it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713146:breakout.h: Ohio State freshman safety C.Gaydosh is now 85 overall and ready to cash in
557713146:breakout.d: Freshman safety [[p:557713146|C.Gaydosh]] jumped six points in a week and is already earning more than similar safeties. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has the deepest NIL pockets in the country, but rival collectives are surely paying attention.

557724443:underpaid.h: Rival collectives are circling Houston's J.Fette, a 91-overall QB earning nothing
557724443:underpaid.d: [[p:557724443|J.Fette]] makes nothing in NIL, while comparable quarterbacks command around 225K. A source says several programs have already asked what it would take to pry him from [[t:832438317|Houston]].

quote.text: Somebody is going to pay that kid, and it won't be long.

557713883:breakout.h: Wisne's jump to 92 puts Ohio State in a good problem
557713883:breakout.d: [[p:557713883|S.Wisne]] is now 92 overall and earning 290K, a lot for a sophomore. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has two strong young quarterbacks, so Tuddy_roosevelt will have to manage both of them.

quote.text: Both guys know what's happening. They know exactly who's pushing who.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557712310:breakout.h: Ohio State WR J.Foster hits 87 overall and is already paid far above the median
557712310:breakout.d: Sophomore receiver [[p:557712310|J.Foster]] is up four points and earns 210K, well above the typical 87-rated receiver. For Tuddy_roosevelt, who is still fixing the receiving corps, he is a keeper at almost any price.

557719074:breakout.h: Ohio State freshman WR T.Neighbors is 84 overall, adding to the receiver depth
557719074:breakout.d: Freshman receiver [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] gained four points and already earns well above the median for his rating. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has to decide how many receivers it can afford to keep.

557726587:breakout.h: A.Noriega's leap at quarterback has Penn State bracing for a bidding war
557726587:breakout.d: The sophomore passer jumped to 89 overall, and Penn State is paying him well below what the market gives quarterbacks of that caliber. Agerm40 may have to move fast to keep him.

quote.text: Every collective in the country has a scout who can read a ratings page. They all see it.

557727185:underpaid.h: D.Coleman is a 91-overall quarterback making nothing. Minnesota may not be the only one calling
557727185:underpaid.d: Coleman's NIL number doesn't match his rating, and the gap is the kind that gets closed when the portal opens. Minnesota is already being mentioned as a possible landing spot.

quote.text: Nobody plays that well for free for long. Someone is going to show him a real offer.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557727231:underpaid.h: E.Crowell is a 92-overall back on a free ride. Alabama can't count on that lasting
557727231:underpaid.d: Alabama has some of the deepest NIL pockets in the country, which is why it hasn't yet had to pay up for Crowell. Rival collectives are reportedly keeping an eye on the situation.

quote.text: Deep pockets only help if you open them before somebody else does.

557712273:fit.h: M.Fayad's patience is being tested in Ohio State's struggling defense
557712273:fit.d: The 82-overall linebacker is in a defense that ranks near the bottom nationally in total tackles, and sources say the frustration has been noticed. Tuddy_roosevelt may have a problem he didn't see coming when the portal opens.

quote.text: He wants to be the guy making plays. Right now the scheme isn't putting him in position to do that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557727038:buried.h: F.Brandon, a 90-overall QB stuck on the bench, is a transfer waiting to happen
557727038:buried.d: The sophomore has taken just 4 snaps in 13 games, and quarterback-needy programs have noticed. If he hits the portal, he won't wait long for a starting job.

quote.text: You don't sit a 90 for that long unless somebody's making a mistake. Every staff that needs a quarterback knows his name.

557725694:buried.h: J. Osborne is a 90-overall back stuck on the Michigan State bench
557725694:buried.d: [[p:557725694|J.Osborne]] is a 90-overall sophomore running back who played just 97 snaps in 13 games. Per a source, he's frustrated with his role at Michigan State. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

557727987:sinking.h: J.Mallory is a 92-overall back stuck on a 4-8 Florida team, and everyone knows it
557727987:sinking.d: Florida's down year hasn't dimmed the sophomore's value, and contenders are already doing homework. If he hits the portal, he'd be the first name on a lot of lists.

quote.text: If he walks, he's the top name on the board. It isn't close.

557713197:sinking.h: A.Carlisle has little to play for at 4-8 Arizona, and contenders know it
557713197:sinking.d: The 91-overall junior quarterback is the kind of player who can change a contender's season. Several staffs are said to be sizing up what it would take to pry him loose.

quote.text: Nobody wants to waste a prime year on a team that isn't winning. Quarterbacks think about that.
quote.by: a source close to a Power conference staff

557723319:sinking.h: B.Woodby is a lockdown corner on a 2-10 Navy team. His next move is the offseason's big question
557723319:sinking.d: A 91-overall junior cornerback doesn't usually end up at a program this far down the standings, and contenders are taking notice. If he enters the portal, he'll be one of the most sought-after players on the market.

quote.text: Corners like that don't hit the market often. When they do, the phones don't stop.

557713146:stayed:2028.h: C. Gaydosh stays at Ohio State as the portal opens
557713146:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557713146|C.Gaydosh]] was on Portal Watch after his rating jump, and the market could have paid him well. He's still with [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. A source says Tuddy_roosevelt's staff checked in with him often.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713883:stayed:2028.h: S. Wisne passes on the portal and stays at Ohio State
557713883:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557713883|S.Wisne]] was on Portal Watch after a rating bump, but he's staying with [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. A source says he wants to see the build through under Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557712310:stayed:2028.h: J. Foster ignores the market and stays at Ohio State
557712310:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557712310|J.Foster]] was on Portal Watch because his rating jump meant bigger collectives could come calling. He's staying at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Per a source, a couple of outside programs got in touch, but he never left the building.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719074:stayed:2028.h: T. Neighbors remains at Ohio State after a quiet portal flirtation
557719074:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] was on Portal Watch after his rating jump, but he's staying at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. The Buckeyes have a growing list of players who will want raises. For now, Tuddy_roosevelt's staff is holding the room together.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726587:stayed:2028.h: A. Noriega was on Portal Watch, but he isn't leaving Penn State
557726587:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557726587|A.Noriega]] drew portal interest after his rating jump, and the portal is open. He's still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster. A source says agerm40's staff made sure he felt heard.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557712273:stayed:2028.h: Ohio State keeps M. Fayad out of the portal
557712273:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557712273|M.Fayad]] had been flagged as a bad scheme fit, which fueled rumors of a move. He's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. People around the program say it was never as close as outsiders made it sound.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713201:stayed:2028.h: M.Carver Stays Home as Penn State Dodges a Portal Exit
557713201:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] spent a week on Portal Watch over scheme-fit concerns, but he's still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster with the window open. agerm40 gets to exhale on this one.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a person familiar with Carver's thinking

557726994:underpaid.h: L.Bey Is a 91-Overall Star on a Backup's Paycheck
557726994:underpaid.d: [[p:557726994|L.Bey]] is making 75K while backs at his level command around 195K. Ohio State has the deepest NIL pockets in the country, so the gap is hard to justify. Rival collectives will notice it too.

quote.text: If I'm a collective with money to spend, he's the first name on my list. You don't find a 91 sitting at that number very often.

557726191:buried.h: Stuck Behind a Starter at ECU, J.Smith May Look Elsewhere
557726191:buried.d: [[p:557726191|J.Smith]] is an 82-overall junior running back with just 143 snaps in 14 games at East Carolina. Pirate_flag has a depth chart problem, and teams in the portal market would start Smith right away.

quote.text: He's a junior, and he can't keep waiting. There are programs that would hand him the job tomorrow.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557718414:struggling.h: D.McCutcheon Hasn't Delivered as a Star Receiver
557718414:struggling.d: [[p:557718414|D.McCutcheon]] has 9 catches for 119 yards in four games, which doesn't fit an 89-overall receiver. The staff faces a decision on his role before next season, and the portal could factor in.

quote.text: Nobody doubts the talent. But the production has to show up eventually, and right now it hasn't.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726191:stayed:2028.h: J.Smith Passes on Portal, Stays Buried at East Carolina
557726191:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557726191|J.Smith]] landed on Portal Watch because of his spot on the depth chart. The portal is open and he's still at [[t:832438301|East Carolina]]. Pirate_flag gets some breathing room in the backfield for now.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557719876:struggling.h: S.Pizzella was sold as a star QB. The tape says he's still a question mark
557719876:struggling.d: The 89-overall quarterback has thrown 22 touchdowns and 15 interceptions, with a 135.5 rating. The staff has a decision to make before next season, and the pressure to make it is growing.

quote.text: He's got every tool you want. But the decisions aren't matching the rating next to his name, and people around the program see it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

561125244commit.h: Penn State's TV pitch lands four-star edge J. Walker
561125244commit.d: [[r:561125244|J. Walker]] wanted a bigger stage, and a source close to the process says [[t:832438366|Penn State]] sold exposure harder than anyone. The reported $270K price tag didn't hurt agerm40's case. It does add to the NIL math in Happy Valley.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561125468commit.h: Alabama gets its man: five-star corner Karapateas picks the Tide
561125468commit.d: [[r:561125468|R. Karapateas]] told people close to him he wanted the most direct road to a title, and [[t:832438274|Alabama]] kept pointing at the trophy case. A rival recruiter conceded privately that the Tide had been ahead for a while.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561125012commit.h: Miami wins five-star QB Tinoisamoa over Boise State, Indiana
561125012commit.d: With [[p:557717016|T.Jones Jr.]] on his way out, [[t:832438337|Miami]] sold [[r:561125012|J. Tinoisamoa]] on a quarterback job with no queue. [[t:832438284|Boise State]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] both thought they had a real shot until late in the process, per a source.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561124415commit.h: Ohio State loses Cobb to Notre Dame, and Tuddy_roosevelt has questions
561124415commit.d: [[r:561124415|M. Cobb]] picked [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. Buckeye insiders had felt good about their standing. The 59-13 rout of [[t:832438403|UTSA]] only made the Irish look more complete.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.

561123248commit.h: Alabama beats Ole Miss and Indiana for T. Page
561123248commit.d: [[r:561123248|T. Page]] chose [[t:832438274|Alabama]] over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. A person close to the family says the title pitch carried the day. The reported $305K ask wasn't the sticking point.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561121800commit.h: Duggan never wavered: Alabama gets another prize recruit
561121800commit.d: Rival staffs stopped calling [[r:561121800|J. Duggan]] weeks ago, a source says. He's headed to [[t:832438274|Alabama]], and the Tide's recruiting board is getting crowded.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561123257commit.h: Toviessi picks Nebraska over Ole Miss and LSU, eyes early snaps
561123257commit.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] has just two returning linebackers, and [[r:561123257|B. Toviessi]] noticed. Staffers at [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438333|LSU]] reportedly viewed the playing-time pitch as the difference.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561121730commit.h: Clemson adds five-star middle linebacker Gooch with a title pitch
561121730commit.d: [[r:561121730|B. Gooch]] wanted a program that sees itself as a contender, and [[t:832438293|Clemson]] made the case on his visit. A high school coach said the family left campus convinced.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561123566commit.h: Ole Miss lands No. 9 overall A. Tyms, softening a recent loss
561123566commit.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] lost [[r:561123248|T. Page]] to Alabama, but [[r:561123566|A. Tyms]] gives the staff a headline win. With [[p:557715633|E.Groves]] leaving after this season, the linebacker room needs him.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561125634commit.h: Indiana answers a rough stretch by landing No. 10 overall Lockett
561125634commit.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has lost out on a couple of recruits recently. [[r:561125634|J. Lockett]] gives it a win built on immediate playing time. A source says the staff promised a real shot at a starting job.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561124798commit.h: Nebraska lands five-star edge Feeney, and the depth chart helped
561124798commit.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] has just two returning edge rushers, and [[r:561124798|G. Feeney]] did the math. Add the reported $280K ask, and the Huskers are quietly stacking their defense.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561121269commit.h: Boise State gets No. 12 overall Mama, a win after two misses
561121269commit.d: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] missed on [[r:561125012|J. Tinoisamoa]] and [[r:561125422|P. Leber]], but the 13-1 record and No. 7 ranking helped close [[r:561121269|D. Mama]]. A source says the early-role promise sealed it.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561125422commit.h: Leber picks Miami over Boise State, Notre Dame for the run defense
561125422commit.d: [[r:561125422|P. Leber]] liked what he saw in [[t:832438337|Miami]]'s run defense, which ranks 11th and allows 104 yards per game. A source says the reported $275K ask wasn't the issue. [[t:832438284|Boise State]] and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] were left behind.

quote.text: The way they run the ball, I fit perfect.

561121668commit.h: Ole Miss had A. Reinbolt from the start
561121668commit.d: Nobody else got a real look. With [[p:557720025|B.Prieskorn]] graduating, [[r:561121668|A. Reinbolt]] saw an open tight end room at [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and committed.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561125244sign.h: J. Walker makes it official at Penn State
561125244sign.d: The paperwork is in. [[r:561125244|J. Walker]] signs with [[t:832438366|Penn State]], and agerm40 can exhale. A source says the staff worried about late calls from other programs.

561125468sign.h: Karapateas signs with Alabama, no drama at the finish
561125468sign.d: [[r:561125468|R. Karapateas]] put pen to paper for [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. A source close to the program says the Tide never really felt threatened. Title expectations come with the signature.

561125012sign.h: Miami locks in Tinoisamoa as the post-Jones era begins
561125012sign.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] sealed the deal with [[r:561125012|J. Tinoisamoa]]. With [[p:557717016|T.Jones Jr.]] leaving, the staff gets a quarterback to build around, and he may arrive expecting to compete immediately.

561124415sign.h: Notre Dame makes M. Cobb's commitment official
561124415sign.d: [[r:561124415|M. Cobb]] signed with [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] is left to wonder what it could have done differently. A source says Cobb's family loved the coaching staff.

561123248sign.h: T. Page signs with Alabama, spurning Ole Miss and Indiana
561123248sign.d: [[r:561123248|T. Page]] made it official, joining the title-chasing [[t:832438274|Alabama]] haul. Rival recruiters had held out hope that a late visit might change things. It didn't.

561121800sign.h: J. Duggan signs with Alabama, as expected
561121800sign.d: The ink is dry on [[r:561121800|J. Duggan]] at [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. His commitment was never in doubt, and the Tide keep stacking prospects while the rest of the board plays catch-up.

561123257sign.h: Nebraska makes it official with Toviessi
561123257sign.d: [[r:561123257|B. Toviessi]] signed with [[t:832438348|Nebraska]], a quiet win for a program that sold power-conference football and a thin linebacker room. A source says the staff is thrilled.

561121730sign.h: Clemson gets Gooch's signature on a title-chasing class
561121730sign.d: [[r:561121730|B. Gooch]] signed with [[t:832438293|Clemson]]. The Tigers' staff reportedly kept in touch right up to the deadline, and the five-star linebacker's decision never wavered.

561123566sign.h: Ole Miss seals the deal with five-star Tyms
561123566sign.d: [[r:561123566|A. Tyms]] signed with [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]], giving the Rebels a splashy piece of their class. A source says the title pitch landed with his family.

561125634sign.h: Indiana locks in Lockett as the early-playing-time pitch pays off
561125634sign.d: [[r:561125634|J. Lockett]] signed with [[t:832438319|Indiana]], and the staff hopes he'll be a Day One contributor. A source says the competition message, not the NIL pitch, won the day.

561124798sign.h: Nebraska seals Feeney, adding pass-rush depth
561124798sign.d: [[r:561124798|G. Feeney]] signed with [[t:832438348|Nebraska]], a program with just two returning edge rushers. A source says he'll push for snaps immediately.

561121269sign.h: Boise State secures five-star receiver D. Mama
561121269sign.d: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] sealed the deal with [[r:561121269|D. Mama]]. For a team that missed on a couple of big names, the WR is a statement signing.

561125422sign.h: P. Leber signs with Miami, a fit for the run defense
561125422sign.d: [[r:561125422|P. Leber]] made it official with [[t:832438337|Miami]]. A source says the staff sold him on a defense that stops the run, and he bought in.

561121668sign.h: A. Reinbolt signs with Ole Miss
561121668sign.d: [[r:561121668|A. Reinbolt]] formalized his commitment to [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]]. With [[p:557720025|B.Prieskorn]] departing, he arrives at a spot where the tight end job could be his early.

561120938commit.h: Georgia Tech lands No. 15 overall Burgess with a QB opening
561120938commit.d: [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] has just one returning quarterback, and [[r:561120938|T. Burgess]] sees a chance to play early. The 45-17 win over [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] didn't hurt. A source says the staff was upfront about the room.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561123051commit.h: Texas Tech wins tug-of-war for dual-threat QB Babalola
561123051commit.d: [[r:561123051|F. Babalola]] picked the Red Raiders after weighing other suitors. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] ranks 11th in passing at 337 yards per game, and a source says the system sold him. The reported $355K ask was met.

quote.text: The way they throw it around, I fit perfect.

561121832commit.h: Texas Tech Wins D. Gray, Selling Playing Time Over Tennessee and Indiana
561121832commit.d: [[r:561121832|D. Gray]] chose [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] over [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. The Red Raiders have only two returning tackles, and the money matched what he was asking.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561123971commit.h: USC Adds Four-Star Corner P. Melvin Jr. While the Notre Dame Win Is Fresh
561123971commit.d: [[t:832438398|USC]] landed [[r:561123971|P. Melvin Jr.]] days after the 31-28 win over [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. [[p:557717122|J.Joseph]] is a senior, so the cornerback room is about to open up.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561124303commit.h: Arkansas Gets Its Safety of the Future in No. 20 Overall T. Green
561124303commit.d: [[r:561124303|T. Green]] picked [[t:832438278|Arkansas]], where [[p:557725247|T.Lockett]] runs out of eligibility after this season. A source close to the recruitment says the conference stage mattered as much as the depth chart.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561121604commit.h: Arizona State Keeps QB B. Beaver Close to Home
561121604commit.d: [[t:832438277|Arizona State]] landed four-star quarterback [[r:561121604|B. Beaver]] by promising a real shot at the job. The short drive from Murrieta also helped. His family was reportedly at the visit.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561124737commit.h: Army's Run-First Pitch Lands Four-Star QB R. Hopkins
561124737commit.d: [[t:832438280|Army]] landed [[r:561124737|R. Hopkins]] by offering something rare at quarterback: a scheme built around running. A source says Hopkins didn't need much convincing once he saw the offense on tape.

quote.text: The way they run the ball, I fit perfect.

561123591commit.h: Ole Miss Gets a Needed Recruiting Win in DT J. Winfield
561123591commit.d: [[r:561123591|J. Winfield]] picked [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] over [[t:832438336|Memphis]] and [[t:832438288|BYU]]. It's a quick answer to the sting of losing T. Page to Alabama. [[p:557727850|A.Kennedy Jr.]] leaves after this season.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561125139commit.h: Oklahoma Pays Up for Four-Star Edge Z. Elee
561125139commit.d: [[r:561125139|Z. Elee]] picked [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] after the Sooners met his reported $385K ask. The program's history of sending defensive linemen to the draft, one in the first round, didn't hurt.

quote.text: I'm taking care of my family. They understood that.

561124155commit.h: Oklahoma Adds WR C. Campbell, and the NIL Machine Keeps Humming
561124155commit.d: [[r:561124155|C. Campbell]] is the second Oklahoma pledge in this class to land with the Sooners at a reported $260K. A source says he wanted a power-conference stage every week, and [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] delivered.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561122145commit.h: Indiana Beats Iowa and Ohio State for T. Coffey on Staff Trust
561122145commit.d: [[r:561122145|T. Coffey]] picked [[t:832438319|Indiana]] over [[t:832438320|Iowa]] and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. That's another miss for Tuddy_roosevelt's staff, and a source says the Buckeyes thought they were in good shape late.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.

557724227:breakout.h: K. Higgins Is Suddenly a 78, and UL Monroe Has a Problem
557724227:breakout.d: The freshman guard jumped 15 points in a week and is earning nothing in NIL. [[t:832438395|UL Monroe]] ranks 133rd in NIL spending, so rival collectives calling this offseason will be hard to answer.

557719911:breakout.h: Missouri State's A.DeCicco Is Growing Too Fast for the Budget
557719911:breakout.d: [[p:557719911|A.DeCicco]], a freshman tackle, is up 14 points to 76 overall and earns nothing. [[t:832438345|Missouri State]] ranks 102nd in NIL spending. Don't be surprised if a bigger school sends a quiet message.

557715131:breakout.h: Auburn Receiver E. Amano Is Now an 80, and Unpaid
557715131:breakout.d: The sophomore jumped 13 points in a week. A source close to the program says the staff knows it needs to get ahead of this before another collective does it for them.

557715590:breakout.h: S. Nunez Is an 84 Now. Texas Has the Money, but Will It Use It?
557715590:breakout.d: The sophomore receiver is up 12 points and still earns nothing, while 84-rated receivers draw a median of 20K nationally. [[t:832438384|Texas]] ranks 13th in NIL, so keeping [[p:557715590|S.Nunez]] should be manageable.

557720370:breakout.h: Missouri Freshman Corner M. Paul Is Now an 82, and Collectives Are Noticing
557720370:breakout.d: [[p:557720370|M.Paul]] is up 12 points in a week and earns nothing. A source says staffs elsewhere have started asking about his contract status. [[t:832438344|Missouri]] will need to act.

557723757:underpaid.h: Bing is an 86 making nothing, and Ohio State can't hide it forever
557723757:underpaid.d: Safety [[p:557723757|K.Bing]] is a top bargain in college football. Players at his position and rating make around 90K, and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]'s ability to ignore that gap is shrinking. This is not a new issue.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he should be making. It's just a question of who calls first.

557725180:fit.h: Ohio State's Passing Game Could Push TE N. Lautar Out the Door
557725180:fit.d: [[p:557725180|N.Lautar]] is an 81-overall vertical threat, but [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] ranks 104th of 138 in receptions. A source says he has noticed, and Tuddy_roosevelt may be hearing from his camp soon.

quote.text: He wants to be a weapon, not a blocker.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557712701:buried.h: Gado is too good to sit, and Ohio State's tackle issue is back
557712701:buried.d: [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] is an 83-overall sophomore tackle with 81 snaps in 12 games. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has not solved his depth chart problem, and someone in the portal would start him tomorrow.

quote.text: He's seen what's happening. He wants a bigger role.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557712426:buried.h: Arizona State's D. Wade Sits Behind the Starter as a 90 Overall
557712426:buried.d: [[p:557712426|D.Wade]] has played just 4 snaps in 14 games. With [[t:832438277|Arizona State]] adding [[r:561121604|B. Beaver]], a source says he may question his path. A quarterback-needy contender would start him tomorrow.

557715842:struggling.h: B. Tuttle Is a 90 on Paper and Invisible on the Stat Sheet
557715842:struggling.d: [[p:557715842|B.Tuttle]] has no catches and no yards in 13 games for a ranked team. A source close to the program says the staff has to decide whether this is a role problem or a fit problem.

quote.text: The talent is there, but the targets aren't.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557717929:struggling.h: USC May Be Done Waiting on J. Reveron to Produce
557717929:struggling.d: [[p:557717929|J.Reveron]] has 10 catches for 120 yards in 12 games despite a 91 overall. A source says [[t:832438398|USC]] has looked at portal receivers.

quote.text: You can't carry a 91 that doesn't touch the ball.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724784:underpaid.h: Rival Collectives Are Calling J. Henderson, and Mississippi State Is Listening
557724784:underpaid.d: [[p:557724784|J.Henderson]] is an 88-overall receiver earning nothing, while peers draw around 80K. A source says [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]] could lose him with one phone call.

557718813:struggling.h: O. Vaughn Has the Rating of a Star and Needs the Role
557718813:struggling.d: [[p:557718813|O.Vaughn]] has 21 catches for 292 yards in 14 games despite an 88 overall on a ranked team. A source says the staff expects him to compete for the job in camp.

quote.text: Nothing is promised. He knows that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557727100:sinking.h: J. Bushnell Deserves Better Than 4-8, and Contenders Know It
557727100:sinking.d: [[p:557727100|J.Bushnell]] is a 91-overall junior receiver stuck on a [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]] team that finished 4-8. A source says winning programs have started to ask about him.

quote.text: If he hits the market, the phones won't stop.

557723757:stayed:2028.h: K.Bing Stays at Ohio State Despite Underpaid Talk
557723757:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557723757|K.Bing]] was on Portal Watch because his rating outran his pay. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. A source close to the program says the money talk happened and it went fine.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557712701:stayed:2028.h: R.Gado Stays Put at Ohio State Even Though He's Buried
557712701:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] looked like a textbook portal candidate, stuck on the depth chart. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff reportedly sat down with him early to lay out a plan.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557725180:stayed:2028.h: Ohio State Holds Onto N.Lautar, Who Looked Like a Scheme Misfit
557725180:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557725180|N.Lautar]] was on Portal Watch as a poor fit for the scheme. The portal is open and he's still at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Whether that's loyalty or a wait-and-see approach is the question for Tuddy_roosevelt's staff.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438301:streakW13.h: East Carolina's 13-0 run has the Pirates believing, and Harrell is selling it
832438301:streakW13.d: [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] is 13-0 and up to No. 2 in the poll. Per a source close to the program, [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] has kept the locker room almost boringly even through all of it.

quote.text: One week at a time. Corny, but it works.

561122840battle.h: Penn State's thin backfield is its pitch to HB Lehan, and Arkansas knows it
561122840battle.d: Four-star HB [[r:561122840|M. Lehan]] wants snaps, and [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has one returning back. That gives it a slight lead over [[t:832438278|Arkansas]], with Georgia lurking. Official visits will likely settle it.

quote.text: He keeps asking who's actually in the room ahead of him. Penn State's answer is a short list.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561122258battle.h: BYU's pass-heavy pitch has Minnesota looking over its shoulder for J. Lindsay
561122258battle.d: Minnesota still holds the lead for [[r:561122258|J. Lindsay]], but playing style is his dealbreaker. [[t:832438288|BYU]] is selling a passing game that fits a route runner. SMU is lurking, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to be a featured piece in the offense. That's the whole conversation right now.
quote.by: a person close to the recruit

561123208battle.h: Nguyen wants to play early, and Minnesota is telling him he will
561123208battle.d: Minnesota has the edge for T. Nguyen, but playing time is the dealbreaker. SMU is pushing, and Tennessee is lurking with a deep-roster pitch. Official visits could swing it.

quote.text: He's not interested in a redshirt year. He's said that to everybody.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561121202battle.h: Minnesota leads for Turpin, but Texas Tech is pitching the NFL hard
561121202battle.d: Pro potential is what matters to J. Turpin, and Texas Tech is chasing Minnesota with a development pitch. SMU sits well back but hasn't gone away. Expect both staffs to push everything they have this week.

quote.text: Every call with Texas Tech comes back to the next level. They know what he's listening for.

561123834battle.h: Pounds wants to stay close to home, and that's a problem for Minnesota
561123834battle.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] leads for four-star WR [[r:561123834|R. Pounds]], but proximity to home is the dealbreaker. That keeps [[t:832438375|SMU]] and TCU in play. Somebody's heart gets broken on signing day.

quote.text: His mom wants him within driving distance. That's not a small thing in this house.
quote.by: a source close to the family

561120014battle.h: Droege is chasing exposure, and SMU barely leads Iowa
561120014battle.d: Brand exposure is the dealbreaker for C. Droege. SMU has a slight edge on Iowa, which isn't going quietly, and Arkansas is lurking. Minnesota fans may notice SMU's name keeps showing up on its board.

quote.text: Iowa thinks the visit changes everything. SMU thinks the TV schedule does.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557725851:breakout.h: Quarterman's 11-point jump leaves East Carolina with an NIL problem
557725851:breakout.d: The junior receiver is up to 80 overall and earning nothing in NIL. [[p:557725851|D.Quarterman]] and [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] may need to talk soon, because bigger programs will be watching film.

quote.text: Guys notice when a teammate jumps like that. So do other collectives.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724319:breakout.h: Gafford is a 90 now, and Penn State's offense has a star to keep
557724319:breakout.d: [[p:557724319|A.Gafford]] jumped to 90 overall, and the sophomore receiver now earns above the going rate. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has more bargaining power than it did last week. Rival programs have taken note.

quote.text: You don't see a jump like that often. Somebody's already asked about him.

557711879:breakout.h: Ohio State's Blue is a 90 and paid like he's not
557711879:breakout.d: Sophomore corner [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] is now 90 overall at 110K in NIL, well under the going rate for corners at his level. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has a gap to close before collectives around the country start calling.

quote.text: A corner like that gets calls from places with deeper pockets. It's only a matter of time.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557713038:breakout.h: Lyle's rise to 89 sharpens Ohio State's quarterback question
557713038:breakout.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is up to 89 overall at 280K, which is more than quarterbacks rated like him usually get. But [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has another sophomore rising behind him, and that makes the roster math awkward for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He's earned the money. He's also looking at that depth chart.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724533:underpaid.h: Rival collectives are circling Ohio State safety Gebhardt
557724533:underpaid.d: [[p:557724533|K.Gebhardt]] is an 84-overall safety making nothing in NIL, and players at his level command around 45K. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has been alerted that other programs are watching.

quote.text: A couple of people have already asked about him. That's usually how it starts.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557716293:underpaid.h: Priester is playing like a star and getting paid like a backup
557716293:underpaid.d: [[p:557716293|G.Priester]] is a 92-overall receiver making nothing in NIL, while players like him make around 130K. In the portal, that gap tends to close quickly.

quote.text: Any receiver would see that gap and ask questions. He's no different.

557723242:underpaid.h: Somebody will back up the truck for Slay. Is Bowling Green ready?
557723242:underpaid.d: [[p:557723242|J.Slay]] is an 86-overall quarterback making 15K, while his peers make around 160K. [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]] ranks 134th in NIL spending, so a bidding war is not exactly its specialty.

quote.text: There's money out there for that kind of QB. Bowling Green can't match it.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557718122:fit.h: A.Cain's role is shrinking on a Penn State defense in crisis against the pass
557718122:fit.d: [[p:557718122|A.Cain]] is an 82-overall lurker linebacker. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ranks 131st of 138 against the pass, and pass defense is where a linebacker like him should make plays. If the defense stays this porous, agerm40 may need to sell him on a fix.

557714021:buried.h: Daulton is too good to sit, and quarterback-needy teams know it
557714021:buried.d: [[p:557714021|J.Daulton]] is a 90-overall junior quarterback with zero snaps in 12 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow, and a few coaches are already thinking about it.

quote.text: He's a quarterback who can win games. He's not going to wait much longer.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557727542:buried.h: W.Griffin is a 91-overall quarterback getting almost no snaps at Georgia Tech
557727542:buried.d: [[p:557727542|W.Griffin]] has played just 97 snaps in 12 games as a junior while sitting No. 2 on the Georgia Tech depth chart. Quarterback-needy programs would start him right away, and the portal is coming.

quote.text: A 91 quarterback sitting on the bench is a gift to anyone who needs one. Someone is going to make the call.

557727531:sinking.h: Green deserves better than 4-8, and contenders will be calling
557727531:sinking.d: [[p:557727531|T.Green]] is a 90-overall junior safety on an Arkansas team that's 4-8. If he hits the portal, it will be the story of the offseason.

quote.text: A safety like that wants to play in January. Arkansas can't offer that right now.

557724852:sinking.h: Hopkins is wasted on a 4-8 Army team and every contender knows it
557724852:sinking.d: [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]] is a 90-overall junior quarterback stuck on an Army team that's 4-8. If he enters the portal, he becomes its top prize.

quote.text: Everyone knows his name. Whoever gets the first call has a real shot.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557715009:sinking.h: Cobb deserves better than Notre Dame's 4-8, and contenders will call
557715009:sinking.d: [[p:557715009|M.Cobb]] is an 89-overall junior middle linebacker on a Notre Dame team that's 4-8. Every contender in the country knows his name.

quote.text: He's a real difference-maker on a team that can't use him.

557718668:struggling.h: A.Hurley is a 90-overall receiver who barely shows up in the box score
557718668:struggling.d: Five catches for 57 yards in three games is thin production for [[p:557718668|A.Hurley]], who has top-tier ratings and a spot on a ranked team. Insiders say the target share isn't there. Another quiet month will invite louder questions about the offense and his future.

quote.text: He's a talented kid who isn't getting the ball. Eventually that becomes a conversation about where he'd be happier.
quote.by: a source close to the program
